title: fix(core): scope ACL deny permissions to the capability execution context
body: `RuntimeAuthority::resolve_access` checked `denied_commands.get(command).map(..).is_some()`, which is true whenever the command has any deny entry regardless of whether the origin matched. A deny scoped to a remote capability therefore also denied the local app. Only deny when an entry's execution context matches the origin, and make the debug message consistent.
